verdict.rationale: There is a free developer account for API access (box-docs-31), but community evidence shows the free tier is quite limited — 250MB max file size and only 10GB monthly bandwidth (box-comm-2, box-comm-5), which is a concrete real-world constraint contradicting the idea of a generous, fully-functional free tier working identically to paid tiers. No published storage quota figure for the free tier appears in official docs. missing for 10: an official published free-tier storage quota page, confirmation that all API/client features work unrestricted on free tier, and resolution of the bandwidth/file-size caps reported by users.
